build_RTMDetInsHead: build an RTMDetInsHead instance with configurable num_prototypes, dyconv_channels, and mask loss settings
forward_RTMDetInsHead: run forward pass on feature tensors to get cls_scores, bbox_preds, kernel_preds, and mask_feat
predict_RTMDetInsHead: predict instance segmentation results with bboxes and masks using predict_by_feat from head outputs
loss_RTMDetInsHead: compute classification, bbox, and mask losses using loss_by_feat during training
build_RTMDetInsSepBNHead: build an RTMDetInsSepBNHead with per-level sep-bn layers and optional shared conv weights
